This service enables eligible individuals to receive professional assessments and consultations from a qualified pharmacist for a range of common health conditions.
outputCopy.localIntroduction:
Worsbrough is a long-established settlement situated in the Metropolitan Borough of Barnsley, South Yorkshire, positioned directly south of Barnsley town centre. The broader area comprises several distinct residential communities, including Worsbrough Bridge, Worsbrough Dale, Ward Green, and Worsbrough Common, shaped historically by local coal mining and industrial manufacturing.

Landmarks and green spaces form a prominent part of the local geography, notably Worsbrough Mill Museum and Country Park, which features a restored 17th-century working watermill, a 60-acre reservoir, and managed nature reserves with walking trails. Local infrastructure includes small shopping parades along Sheffield Road, primary schools, community centres, and local healthcare facilities such as Worsbrough Health Centre.

To help address everyday health requirements across the locality, Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic delivers the Pharmacy First service for eligible residents from the area. Through Pharmacy First, individuals experiencing certain common health conditions can receive a formal consultation with a pharmacist. The pharmacist conducts a thorough assessment covering current symptoms, relevant medical history, and any existing medicines. Based on this individual clinical assessment, outcomes may include self-care advice, suitable treatment options, or a direct referral to another healthcare professional.
outputCopy.relationshipToPharmacy: Consultations take place at Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic in Darfield. Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic is approximately 5.6 km in a straight line from Worsbrough.
